title: Identity - Updated
description: Original Identity mod from Draylar, but forked to fix for latest Forge 1.20.1
body:
# Identity

*Identity* is a mod inspired by [Morph](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/morph)

## Credit

[Original Identity Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/identity)

This project is an unofficial fixed version of the original Identity mod created by Draylar. All credit for the original concept and the vast majority of the implementation belongs to the original author.

Additionally, significant portions of this README are adapted from the original project's page.

Thank you to Draylar for creating and open-sourcing the original mod.

---

**Required Libraries**

Forge => [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api/version/9.2.14+forge)

---

With *Identity*, you can become anything you want, friend or foe, hot or cold, fluffy or rough.

![Draylar, the original author of the mod, disguised as a sheep among other mobs.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xxA9dBsF/images/b7ce796ffff3b9ab7832a95095e71550ba408304.png)

![An image determining you can gather identities by defeating mobs.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xxA9dBsF/images/22f14843bdcc038992508f9491d905f7e2cc94ea.png)

![An image determining you can equip identities to change your appearance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xxA9dBsF/images/c4a5aa65648de1e2bf3282e29a011532e58e75a4.png)

![An image determining you can discover special mob abilites and interactions from identities](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xxA9dBsF/images/1d3a4086a1ee9c8b2ab2054237d94cb5ec9a10d4.png)

### Getting Started

To unlock an *Identity*, kill a nearby mob. You'll see a notification above your hotbar informing you of the unlock. You can then press the ` key to swap between identities.
